photos.title: Condo towers and low-rise condo buildings on North Waccamaw Drive, Garden City Beach, USGS oblique aerial photo, August 24, 2011
photos.what: A stretch of oceanfront at Garden City Beach seen from a plane over the ocean: low-rise condo buildings with pools on the left, a tall tan tower in the middle, a white five-story building with a pool and the edge of another tower on the right. Streets of beach houses run back from the shore road to a wide salt marsh, with more houses on the far side of the marsh. Beach umbrellas line the sand; people are too small to recognize.
photos.caption: Garden City Beach, outside city limits: a condo tower and low-rise condo buildings on North Waccamaw Drive, with the marsh behind, seen from a plane in 2011.
photos.alt: A tall tan condo tower and several low-rise condo buildings with pools on the beach at Garden City, with beach houses and a wide salt marsh behind them

place.sublocation: North Waccamaw Drive, Garden City Beach, unincorporated Horry County (tax district 610)

Fetched 2026-11-03 by the fixer for /invest/condos/. Not used on any other page.

No sign, plate or building name is readable at page size; people are specks. Horry County parcels layer 24, condo units (land use 1xx, building value above 0, legal description with HPR) in envelope -78.996 33.578 to -78.984 33.588, read 2026-11-03: every condo regime in the envelope is tax district 610, which is not a city district (README "Area": 550 North Myrtle Beach, 88x and 89x City of Myrtle Beach, 660 Surfside Beach, 110 Conway; the rest is outside city limits): Sea Oaks, Sandy Shores, Reflections, Afterdeck, Sea Watch VI, Portobello II, Angler Villas and others. Roads, layer 18: N WACCAMAW DR and RAINBOW DR, postal city GARDEN CITY.

photos.title: The salt marsh behind the beach strip from above
photos.what: The salt marsh behind the beach strip from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): Salt marsh and tidal water fill the frame; houses with docks stand at the left edge and the lower right; the Atlantic Avenue causeway crosses at the upper right.
photos.caption: The salt marsh behind the beach strip, with docks from the houses on both edges.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of the salt marsh at Garden City at high tide, with long private docks running out from houses on the mainland at left and on the beach strip at lower right

place.sublocation: The salt marsh south of Atlantic Avenue
